### 2026-10-09 – i was able to get all of the software setup!

**2h**

i was able to get all of the software setup!

i first set up this half life account, then i set up my lapse and hackatime accounts; however, to do that i needed a github code spaces account first.
then, i worked on getting the files provided in the guide into kicad, which i also had to set up. i had a bit of trouble setting up a new project b/c my computer kept crashing but i got one set up! (i think its correct but the *ominous foreshadowing* is making me worried)
i also got my slack account setup!

i don't really thin kthis is much (especially b/c i haven't even started the schematics or coding sections yet), but it

 took me a while to get these all setup becuse i haven't used any of these programs before :(
